name: io.github.trakkr-aisearch/openai-ads-mcp
title: OpenAI Ads MCP
description: OpenAI Ads MCP for ChatGPT Ads campaigns, creatives, audiences, insights, and conversions.

headers.name: X-OpenAI-Ads-API-Key
headers.description: OpenAI Ads API key from Ads Manager. Required only for Ads API tool calls; discovery, initialize, and tools/list work without it.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI Ads API key from Ads Manager. Scoped to one ad account.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for first connection so write tools are hidden.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
environmentVariables.description: Optional budget guard for spend-changing tools, in the ad account's currency (major units). Defaults to 100. Legacy OPENAI_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING_USD is still read as a fallback.
